cover_letter.greeting: Dear Goldman Sachs AWM Client Solutions Group Management & Strategy Team,
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Management & Strategy Analyst role in the AWM Client Solutions Group. I'm an MBA (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli, and before that I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. I liked that this team sits close to the business, using reporting and analytics to help leadership run a large client franchise. Having worked in asset management, that's the kind of seat where I think I can be useful quickly.

At JPMorgan Asset Management I turned large datasets into executive reporting and dashboards for senior leadership, and benchmarking past marketing budget allocations identified 30% in efficiency gains. At Lenovo I owned the mapping and QA on AI-powered dashboards that saved 4+ hours a week of reporting, and turned variance and trend analysis into clear recommendations for teams across the business. I also hold a Tableau Data Analytics & Visualization certification.

That maps well to the team's work on management reporting, Excel and PowerPoint deliverables and keeping projects on track. I'm careful with detail and comfortable juggling several requests at once. I'd welcome the chance to talk about the role.
